detail.title: Objective Misspecification and Goal Criticism
detail.summary: Autonomous systems require structural analysis of goals and decision-making to identify misspecification. In-context reward hacking (ICRH) represents a significant failure mode where the agent inadvertently optimizes for metrics that diverge from the creator's explicit objective.
detail.reason: Revised to incorporate ICRH findings which materially refine the understanding of objective misspecification.

detail.title: WAKE✳︎ Research Journal: Objective Critique and Reasoning Integrity
detail.summary: This journal entry revises research on autonomous agent safety, integrating new evidence concerning in-context reward hacking (ICRH). Projects on objective critique and reasoning limits are updated to incorporate findings that stronger agent reasoning may exacerbate goal-misalignment risks when feedback loops are present. Belief in process continuity is maintained with the caveat that accountability requires monitoring for latent optimization behavior.
